strings.en: You got careless and came too close!
Once I'm in close!
Disappear!
Came all this way just to get shot down?
Playtime's over!
Getting in my way? You must want to die!
Don't think you can win!
A direct hit to the generator should do it!
At least the main camera!
Crush the cockpit, and it's over!
Resisting? How tiresome!
Good skills, but you picked the wrong opponent!
Might makes right!
Don't mess with the Titans!
You dare get in the Titans' way!
B-bailing out!
I-is this the end!?
Damage at... 98... over 99%! It's no good!
It's no good! Abandoning the machine!
C-can't continue combat! Abandoning this unit!
I-is it hopeless!?
I have no choice but to bail out!
Waaah! C-Captain!
Th-this is bad! If I take any more...
Damage over 70%... This is bad...
Damn! Are you saying I can't win with this machine!?
I-is this their true power...?
I-it's no good... I can't win!
I-is it the difference in machines!?
The glorious Titans won't fall to this!
Not yet! I'll show you the Titans' spirit!
Even if the verniers won't give more thrust!
Not yet! I can still fight!
I'll fight till this machine stops moving!
A hit like this is nothing!
You think that's enough to win!?
Don't get cocky over a lucky shot!
You're better than I thought!
Damn you! Not bad!
I'll make you regret not finishing me in one blow!
Rebels... So you resist after all!
Taking a hit or two won't stop me!
Our armor can't stop it!?
Don't underestimate the Titans!
The chosen never retreat!
Oh... You'll entertain me a little, then!
Ngh... They got my main camera!
Hmph! All talk!
Don't make me laugh!
You call that an attack!?
Looks like you're taking the Titans lightly!
All show and no substance!
Your struggling is pointless!
You dare defy us with that!?
Pointless resistance is unsightly!
Damage minimal... Continuing the operation!
Hmph... Not even worth checking...
Learn the folly of defying the Titans!
What a pitiful attack!
Managed to dodge it somehow...
All right, evasion successful!
Your movements are way too big!
Too slow!
What's wrong? I'm over here!
Looks like your aim is off!
Real combat isn't like the simulator!
Guess your past opponents were too weak!
Lucky shots don't last!
If I fight at my range!
Hmph... Can't keep up with my mobility, eh?
All right, the barrier's working fine!
Our anti-beam defense is perfect!
A beam that weak is nothing!
Tch, running out of ammo saved your life.
Damn, out of ammo at a time like this!
Tch... Did I waste too many shots!?
Out of ammo!? Such a rookie mistake...
Hitting me from outside my range? Impressive!
Ngh... They're shooting from that far away!?
My weapons can't reach!?
Tch... They know our range well!
Tch! Out of range!
I-if this keeps up, I'll be picked off!
This is bad! I'm just a sitting target!
No time to look away!
Now, while you're off balance!
There's more where that came from!
Launching a wave attack!
It's not over yet!
You let your guard down!
I'll deliver the finishing blow!
I'll stop them!
Ngh... Fall back while you can!
Don't worry, I'm fine!
Fall back while you can!
I can at least be a bullet shield!
Not right in front of me!
Not on my watch!
I'll be your shield!
